statement: Pinned Dolphin's EncryptedExtension model stores the extension encryption enable state at register 0xF0, recognizes 0xAA as enabled, treats writes overlapping 0x40-0x4F as making the key dirty, and regenerates the key on a subsequent encrypted bus read before encrypting the returned bytes based on address and size. It has separate first-party and third-party key generators. Unlike the pinned rnconrad emulator's 0x4C-specific immediate table generation, this source model updates lazily on reads following any overlapping key-region write; hardware sequencing remains unresolved.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Extension.h 70-115; Extension.cpp 77-121,145-153; software disagreement in key regeneration trigger with wii-gap-rnconrad-encryption-key-trigger, no crypto code or keys copied.
